jobs.title: Director, Supply Chain Automation
jobs.description_text:
WHY JOIN ALO?

Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. It changes who yogis are off the mat, making their lives and their communities better. That’s the real meaning of studio-to-street: taking the consciousness from practice on the mat and putting it into practice in life.

OVERVIEW

The Director, Supply Chain Automation leads the design, deployment, and performance of automation programs across ALO's distribution network. Reporting to the Vice President, Distribution Center Automation, this leader turns ALO's automation strategy into results by taking projects from business case and design through implementation, go-live, stabilization, and ongoing optimization. 

This role is hands-on and execution-focused. The Director leads a team of automation engineers and project leaders, manages integrator and vendor partners day to day, and works closely with DC Operations to make sure automation runs as part of daily operations rather than as standalone technology. jobs.title: Senior Project Manager (Intralogistics and Robotics)
jobs.description_text: Do you dream of deploying the perfect picking robots in warehouses all around the world? Are you ready to learn the new, exciting world of smart robots? Are you excited about joining a startup and contributing to building its future? Would you like to cooperate with top professionals in our industry? We’re now looking for a Senior Project Manager who’s ready to help us scale and deploy many robots in our clients’ warehouses!
